high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a Twitter post. The tweet is from the verified account of actor Manoj Bajpayee (@BajpayeeManoj). The tweet expresses shock and grief over the death of an individual named Siddharth Shukla, who passed away after a heart attack at Mumbai's Cooper Hospital. The text reads: "OMG!!! This is So Shocking!!! Words will fail to describe the shock and sense of loss of his near and dear ones !!! May he rest in peace !!! 🙏🙏 No yaar !!!!" Below Manoj Bajpayee's tweet, there is a reply
